title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE FOUNDATION FOR BROADCAST CULTURE ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters mandated by the Foundation for Broadcast Culture Act and those necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Grounds for disqualification) A person who served as an advisor or a consultant pursuant to Article 8 (1) 5 and Article 10-2 (1) 5 of the Act shall be a person who provided advisory or consulting services as a member of an election-related organization, such as an advisory group, a group of advisors, a special advisory group, or a committee established within an election office, an election liaison office, or an election campaign organization under Article 61 of the Public Official Election Act.

Article 3 (Disclosure of remuneration for executive officers) (1) In accordance with Article 15-2 of the Act, the FBC shall disclose the remuneration and other related information of its executive officers on the website of FBC within 30 days from the end of each quarter.
  (2) The FBC shall comply with the standards specified in each of the following subparagraphs when making disclosures under paragraph (1):
  1. For matters specified in subparagraph 1 of Article 15-2 of the Act: The remunerations and various allowances for the executive officers shall be classified by kind;
  2. For matters regarding the details of payment of business promotion expenses specified in subparagraph 2 of Article 15-2 of the Act: The purpose and date of payment, number of persons eligible for the expenses, amount of expenses, and other relevant details shall be classified by each case of payment.
  [This Article Added on Apr. 19, 2022]
